tokens.name: slate
tokens.usage: The main background. Centre of the radial ground behind WaveBackground, and the page colour wherever the background is not drawn.

tokens.name: slate-deep
tokens.usage: Edge of the radial ground: radial-gradient(120% 90% at 50% 40%, slate, slate-deep). Also a darker surface on slate (1.2:1, so give it a border if it must read as separate).

tokens.name: navy
tokens.usage: Accent 1: the navy glow bands. Light, not ink: 1.5:1 on slate, so never use it for text or a control's only boundary.

tokens.name: green
tokens.usage: Accent 2: the green glow bands. Also usable as an accent mark or text on slate (6.7:1) and slate-deep (8.3:1).

tokens.name: floor-you-low
tokens.usage: Floors: the lower, larger glow bands of the water on your own floor. The same as navy, so your own floor looks as the shell always has. Light, never ink.

tokens.name: floor-you-high
tokens.usage: Floors: the upper glow bands on your own floor. The same as green.

tokens.name: floor-team-low
tokens.usage: Floors: the lower glow bands on every team's floor: a warm coral, one colour for all teams so it always means "shared with my team". Light, never ink; teams are told apart by name and breadcrumb.

tokens.name: floor-team-high
tokens.usage: Floors: the upper glow bands on a team's floor, warm amber. Also the team mark on the floor gauge (6.9:1 on slate).

tokens.name: floor-org-low
tokens.usage: Floors: the lower glow bands on the org's floor, a deep navy that reads as the deepest, quietest water. Light, never ink.

tokens.name: floor-org-high
tokens.usage: Floors: the upper glow bands on the org's floor. Also the org mark on the floor gauge (5.1:1 on slate).

tokens.name: ink
tokens.usage: Text over the background, on slate (8.8:1) and slate-deep (10.8:1). Taken from the tuner panel's text colour.

tokens.name: ink-muted
tokens.usage: Secondary text on slate (5.1:1) and slate-deep (6.3:1). Taken from the tuner panel's muted colour.

tokens.name: surface-pane
tokens.usage: Level 1. The flat working plane content sits on: a list, a document, a table, a run log. Blurs the water behind it. ink on it is 7:1 or better even over the brightest band; ink-muted can fall to about 4.3:1 over a bright band, so keep it to 13px+.

tokens.name: surface-raised
tokens.usage: Level 2. One thing lifted off the pane or the water: a card, a sheet. Blurred, with a soft shadow (shadow-raised).

tokens.name: surface-inset
tokens.usage: Recessed inside a pane or raised surface: a preview, a quote, a draft. No border, no shadow.

tokens.name: surface-overlay
tokens.usage: Level 3. A decision over everything, such as an approval. Always on a veil; never more than one.

tokens.name: surface-bar
tokens.usage: Solid strips, such as an app bar if one is ever needed. Opaque, no blur. The shell's band and Title's letterbox are never solid: they use scrim.

tokens.name: scrim
tokens.usage: The fade the shell's chrome rests on, so its words stay readable over bright water or an app: under the top band, and Title's letterbox top and bottom. Always a gradient from this to transparent, never a block.

tokens.name: veil
tokens.usage: Darkens the water (and anything on it) to bring one thing forward. Used behind Glance and overlays, as a radial fade from about 35% at the centre.

tokens.name: hairline
tokens.usage: 1px borders on surfaces and dividers between rows. Decorative only.

tokens.name: hairline-strong
tokens.usage: Outlines that must be seen: pills, chips, the ask line at rest.

tokens.name: danger
tokens.usage: Danger: things that can’t be undone. The Danger button’s outline, mark and armed fill; error text. 4.7:1 on slate, 5.8:1 on slate-deep; slate-deep on it is 5.8:1.

tokens.name: warning
tokens.usage: Warning: something needs care but nothing is broken (a sync is stale, a run is slow). 7.7:1 on slate. Never on buttons.

tokens.name: success
tokens.usage: Success: something finished well (sent, saved, done). Suggested: a yellower green than the accent, so “done” never reads as “look now”. 7.4:1 on slate. Never on buttons; the accent green stays the action colour.

tokens.name: info
tokens.usage: Information and focus: the industry blue, at the step that reads on dark (blue-500 #3B82F6 is only 3.5:1 on slate). Neutral notices and links. 5.1:1 on slate.

tokens.name: focus
tokens.usage: The keyboard focus ring and the focused input’s underline. Always info blue, so focus never looks like an action (green) or a state.

tokens.name: light
tokens.usage: Specular light on glass: Bubble highlights and the glint on a focused bubble. Never text, never a fill.

tokens.name: shade
tokens.usage: Shadow and masks: the darkness under raised things and overlays, and opaque stops in mask gradients. Never text.

effect.note: The Calm Tide (default) values for the glow. Variants carry their own; see WaveBackground.

tokens.name: glow-blur
tokens.usage: Blur on the band canvas. Higher is softer (Minimal uses 40px); lower draws lines (Sonar Line uses 6px).

tokens.name: glow-saturate
tokens.usage: Saturation boost on the band canvas.

tokens.name: grain-opacity
tokens.usage: Opacity of the fractal-noise grain laid over everything.

tokens.name: breathe
tokens.usage: How far each band's intensity swells and fades (0 = steady).

tokens.name: surface-blur
tokens.usage: Backdrop blur on panes, raised surfaces and overlays.

radius.note: Corners. The water and panes are soft; controls are pills.

tokens.name: radius-key
tokens.usage: Keycaps, source numbers, small number keys: the smallest rounded things.

tokens.name: radius-inset
tokens.usage: Inset areas: previews, quotes.

tokens.name: radius-card
tokens.usage: Panes, raised cards, overlays, sheets (top corners only).

tokens.name: radius-pill
tokens.usage: Buttons, chips, pills, toasts.

shadow.note: Panes are flat: no shadow. Elevation shows through blur and, from raised up, a soft shadow.

tokens.name: shadow-raised
tokens.usage: Raised cards and sheets.

tokens.name: shadow-overlay
tokens.usage: Overlays (approvals).

spacing.note: Harry, from the Foundations Lab: golden-ratio steps on a 4px unit, snapped to 4px (4 × 1, 1.618, 2.618, 4.236, 6.854, 11.09, 17.94, 29.03). Values under 4px are geometry, not spacing.

tokens.name: space-1
tokens.usage: Inside a cluster that reads as one thing: a fact’s value to its label, chip padding, a menu item to its detail.

tokens.name: space-2
tokens.usage: Inside a control or a tight list: a keycap to its word, step rows, an eyebrow to a small title.

tokens.name: space-3
tokens.usage: Eyebrow to title, title to summary, row padding, an icon to its text.

tokens.name: space-4
tokens.usage: Between related blocks: a question to its answers, an icon to its heading, an inset inside a pane.

tokens.name: space-5
tokens.usage: Between groups: actions in a row, the facts on a card, padding beside a button’s label.

tokens.name: space-6
tokens.usage: Before the actions; padding inside panes, cards and overlays.

tokens.name: space-7
tokens.usage: Between sections; the gap between columns.

tokens.name: space-8
tokens.usage: The largest gap: section breaks on long pages, and space above a pane under the top band.

structure.note: DRAFT (Claude). Where things go, how wide they get, and what sits over what. Measures: the five widths, always min(measure, 100% minus two gutters), centred on the axis. Anchors: fixed positions between the top and bottom bands. Layers: stacking order for whole components; inside one, use 0 to 3.

tokens.name: measure-card
tokens.usage: One raised card (Glance Card).

tokens.name: measure-decision
tokens.usage: One decision (AgentApproval).

tokens.name: measure-glance
tokens.usage: A quick look, centred on the veil (Glance Veil).

tokens.name: measure-read
tokens.usage: The reading and asking column: the agent session, its ask line, a response.

tokens.name: measure-wide
tokens.usage: The widest thing on screen: a pane or a sheet. Two columns at most inside it.

tokens.name: measure-prose
tokens.usage: Longest line of running summary text inside any measure.

tokens.name: edge
tokens.usage: The gutter: chrome's distance from the left and right edges, and the minimum clear space either side of any container.

tokens.name: edge-tight
tokens.usage: The gutter below 640px wide, and either side of a sheet.

tokens.name: band-top
tokens.usage: Height of the top band. Holds chrome (name left, status right) and nothing else; view headings start at its foot.

tokens.name: band-bottom
tokens.usage: Height of the bottom band. Holds the ask line and the Esc key; content stops above it.

tokens.name: anchor-ask
tokens.usage: Distance of the ask line from the bottom edge.

tokens.name: anchor-back
tokens.usage: Distance of the Esc key and key hints from the bottom edge.

tokens.name: focal
tokens.usage: The focal point: the menu's focused item and any centred glance sit on it. Centred blocks sit 4% high of it (optical centre).

tokens.name: letterbox
tokens.usage: Height of each letterbox bar in the Title layouts.

tokens.name: layer-ground
tokens.usage: WaveBackground.

tokens.name: layer-menu
tokens.usage: CentreMenu.

tokens.name: layer-glance
tokens.usage: A Glance, with its veil, over the menu.

tokens.name: layer-view
tokens.usage: A full view (session, workspace, builder) over the menu.

tokens.name: layer-overlay
tokens.usage: An overlay on its veil: AgentApproval.

tokens.name: layer-chrome
tokens.usage: The top band: name and status stay visible over everything except the intro.

tokens.name: layer-intro
tokens.usage: The opening wordmark.

tokens.name: layer-toast
tokens.usage: AgentToast: the one thing allowed above everything.

styles.name: w-text-label
styles.usage: Eyebrows, fact labels, keycaps, section labels. Always uppercase and tracked, in ink-muted. Set uppercase.

styles.name: w-text-small
styles.usage: Back, notes, context lines, the clock's companions. The smallest normal-case text.

styles.name: w-text-meta
styles.usage: Details, rows, pills, steps, chips: the dense working text.

styles.name: w-text-body
styles.sample: Reads your mail and tells you what needs you.
styles.usage: Summaries, answers, buttons, options: anything read as a sentence.

styles.name: w-text-lead
styles.sample: Ask Briefing, or type / for actions
styles.usage: The focused menu item, the ask line, a question: one line that leads.

styles.name: w-text-heading
styles.usage: View titles, an approval's question, the first line of an answer.

styles.name: w-text-title-s
styles.usage: Card and sheet titles, large fact values.

styles.name: w-text-display
styles.usage: The Split title: the one big word on a screen.

styles.name: w-text-display-fluid
styles.usage: Title-layout titles (letterbox). Uppercase, wide tracking, weight 200. Fluid: clamp(40px, 7vw, 80px) in CSS; shown here at its ceiling.

styles.name: w-text-hero
styles.usage: The intro wordmark only. Fluid: clamp(48px, 9vw, 112px) in CSS; shown here at its ceiling.

tracking.note: Letter-spacing, as foundations. Capitals are always tracked; running text never is.

tokens.name: tracking-tight
tokens.usage: Large titles in normal case (title, display), pulled in slightly.

tokens.name: tracking-soft
tokens.usage: Small words that sit beside icons: presence labels, Bubble category names.

tokens.name: tracking-caps
tokens.usage: Capitals inside controls: every labelled button and suggestion pill.

tokens.name: tracking-label
tokens.usage: Small capital labels: eyebrows, fact labels, section labels, keys hints.

tokens.name: tracking-title
tokens.usage: The Title tier: chapter labels and the film-title type.

tokens.name: tracking-mark
tokens.usage: The wordmark only.

motion.note: DRAFT (Claude). Durations and easing. Motion is slow and continuous on the water, quick and quiet on controls. Everything still works with prefers-reduced-motion: things appear in place instead of moving.

tokens.name: motion-instant
tokens.usage: Colour and opacity on hover: a word brightening, an outline appearing.

tokens.name: motion-quick
tokens.usage: Small things that answer a press: a menu opening, a row's actions appearing, a closing panel.

tokens.name: motion-base
tokens.usage: Most changes of state: a field's line, a toggle's track, the bulk bar, the veil.

tokens.name: motion-slow
tokens.usage: Something arriving: a dialog rising, a popover, the tide sliding a day, Search opening.

tokens.name: motion-calm
tokens.usage: A scene changing: the Shell's sky, a Glance, the menu stepping back.

tokens.name: motion-spin
tokens.usage: One turn of a working arc (a busy button, Running).

tokens.name: motion-run
tokens.usage: One pass of the hairline that runs under a busy field or a loading state.

tokens.name: motion-shimmer
tokens.usage: One sweep of a skeleton's shimmer.

tokens.name: motion-ping
tokens.usage: One ring of the ping: look now.

tokens.name: motion-still
tokens.usage: Loops slowed right down under prefers-reduced-motion.

tokens.name: motion-hold
tokens.usage: How long an Undo stays offered.

tokens.name: motion-drift
tokens.usage: Ambient loops that should never be noticed: the Bubble's iridescent swirl, an idle agent breathing. (The water runs on its own engine.)

tokens.name: ease-standard
tokens.usage: Changes in place: colour, lines, fills.

tokens.name: ease-out
tokens.usage: Things arriving: they move fast, then settle. Dialogs, popovers, the tide.

tokens.name: ease-in
tokens.usage: Things leaving: they start gently and go.

tokens.name: ease-spring
tokens.usage: A small part settling with a touch of overshoot: a toggle's knob, a radio's dot. Never a panel.

tokens.name: ease-ping
tokens.usage: The ping's ring: out fast, fading slow.
